title: A separated locally quasi-finite morphism has property A
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma verifies property (A) for a separated locally quasi-finite morphism of schemes (statement lines 5794-5798, with property (A) delivered verbatim as a context span from lines 5708-5726). The proof isolates the given point in its fibre using local quasi-finiteness (proof lines 5800-5812), then uses separation to find an etale neighbourhood of the base over which the base change splits off a piece containing the point together with a morphism to the given etale U (proof lines 5812-5840), which is precisely the condition of property (A) (proof lines 5840-5849). The non-formal content is the use of separation to make the isolation uniform over the base. The claim is H2: one geometric construction, written out.
